map.本工具用于替代（产品/方案/推荐）支持的实时计算，依据对应公式与标准运算规则处理: This tool is used for real-time calculation of alternative (product / solution / recommendation) support, processing according to the corresponding formula and standard operation rules, outputting results in real time by precision; pure front-end, data not uploaded.
map.软件选型比价：快速列出主流软件的替代方案: Software selection comparison: quickly list mainstream software alternatives
map.降本替换：评估开源或低成本替代选项: Cost-down replacement: evaluate open-source or low-cost alternatives
map.头脑风暴：为方案汇报准备备选清单: Brainstorming: prepare a candidate list for solution reports
map.用法：输入需要生成的条数 n（1~50，默认 5），工具从内置的 16 组常见软: Usage: enter the number n of items to generate (1 to 50, default 5); the tool shuffles the built-in 16 common software-alternative groups and takes the first n, each giving the original software name and 3 alternatives (open-source and commercial). When n exceeds 16 it loops back to the pool start.
map.例：输入 5 → 输出 5 条，如「1. Adobe Photoshop → 替: Example: enter 5 outputs 5 items, such as 1. Adobe Photoshop to alternatives: GIMP, Krita, Photopea; 2. AutoCAD to alternatives: FreeCAD, LibreCAD, BricsCAD, etc.; each click gives a different order and combination. Enter 20, since the pool has only 16, items 17 to 20 loop back to the pool start, e.g. Adobe Photoshop appears again.
map.为什么每次结果不一样？: Why are results different each time?
map.工具对备选池做随机打乱后取前 n 条，因此重复点击会得到不同顺序与组合，适合做头: The tool shuffles the candidate pool and takes the first n, so repeated clicks give different orders and combinations, suited to brainstorming-style candidate lists; to keep a stable result, record that output.
map.备选池只有 16 条吗？: Does the candidate pool have only 16 items?
map.当前内置 16 组常见软件（覆盖办公、图像、剪辑、CAD、数值计算、统计、协作、: The current built-in 16 common software (covering office, image, editing, CAD, numerical computing, statistics, collaboration, meeting, analysis, API debugging, BI, design, editor, container, AI and so on) alternatives; entering more than 16 loops. Specific software alternatives can be supplemented with search.
